articles.title: Building of the Pep supremacy is an era that will be defined by sham-ball
articles.dek: Guardiola’s success at Manchester City was underpinned by financial cheating. Now he can only double down on his adherence to the owners “Do you know the question that…
articles.description: Guardiola’s success at Manchester City was underpinned by financial cheating. Now he can only double down on his adherence to the owners “Do you know the question that you are asking me? Today, do you honestly think it is my job to make this kind of question happen …” Cut to the long, painful pause. Chuck in a deep, shaming stare, eyes that have suddenly become death rays of betrayal and disgust and Pep Guardiola himself transformed from a man cheerfully toasting his own FA Cup final victory to a grizzled chief detective addressing a room full of convicted perverts. Guardiola had the wind entirely at his back at this point, sitting in the Wembley press room an hour after Manchester City’s 6-0 defeat of Watford in May 2019 . Success drowns out every other noise in football. To be good is also to be good , noble, virtuous. History is written by the domestic treble winners. Right up until the moment it isn’t. Continue reading...

articles.dek: Work provided information concerning City’s finances He called City decision ‘historic for English football’ Rui Pinto, whose leaks of private documents helped to trigger…
articles.description: Work provided information concerning City’s finances He called City decision ‘historic for English football’ Rui Pinto, whose leaks of private documents helped to trigger the Premier League’s investigation into Manchester City’s financial affairs, will no longer be protected as a witness by the Portuguese authorities, it can be revealed. The removal of the whistleblower’s protection was decided on Wednesday, according to documents seen by the Guardian. Pinto has also been advised to “exercise caution with family contacts” and avoid social media. The 37-year-old, who is the man behind the website Football Leaks, has been a protected witness since 2020, after agreeing to grant Portuguese authorities access to millions of files gathered before his arrest. articles.description: Head coach sees Real Madrid man as an option up front Kane praises Alexander-Arnold’s impact and work rate Thomas Tuchel’s hunt for alternatives to Harry Kane has led to him identifying Jude Bellingham as an option at No 9 for England. Kane continued his remarkable scoring record in the 2-0 win against Czechia in the Nations League on Tuesday, moving to 87 goals in 123 international appearances with a late strike in Prague, but he has little cover up front. There is no prospect yet of Tuchel having to consider life without Kane. The England head coach backed the 33-year-old striker to last another decade at the highest level, tipped him to reach a century of international goals soon, and said England cannot expect to produce a replica of their greatest forward. articles.title: Craig Bellamy urges Wales improvement but wary of Norway’s threat
articles.dek: Wales ‘unrecognisable’ in defeat against Denmark Haaland ‘exactly the same’ after Manchester City verdict Craig Bellamy has said Wales must improve against Norway on…
articles.description: Wales ‘unrecognisable’ in defeat against Denmark Haaland ‘exactly the same’ after Manchester City verdict Craig Bellamy has said Wales must improve against Norway on Thursday after appearing unrecognisable in their defeat against Denmark , and highlighted their next opponents’ run to the World Cup quarter-finals as proof of their talent. Wales host Norway in Cardiff hoping to record their first win since last November and their first since promotion to Nations League A. “This team has been on a surge,” he said of Ståle Solbakken’s side. “They are progressing and they will keep going as well – they ain’t going away, especially with the youngsters they’ve got coming through. articles.title: Daily | The big story is of course … Scotland fans pining for another home run
articles.dek: Sign up now! Sign up now! Sign up now? Sign up now! In the four matches they’ve sat through since their unconvincing Geopolitics World Cup win over Haiti, it must rankle…
articles.description: Sign up now! Sign up now! Sign up now? Sign up now! In the four matches they’ve sat through since their unconvincing Geopolitics World Cup win over Haiti, it must rankle among diehard conscripts of the Tartan Army that the only sporting moment they’ve been able to celebrate with genuine wild abandon remains a Wyatt Langford home run biffed out of the stadium for the Texas Rangers at Fenway Park. Away from the diamond, fairly meek surrenders by Scotland to Morocco and Brazil led to Steve Clarke’s resignation, which in turn prompted Sébastien Pocognoli to surf in on a wave of cautious fan suspicion. Following an extremely promising second-half display in his first game against Slovenia – one that obviously featured no goals, a couple of missed sitters and plenty of attacking verve from his side – the Belgian had plenty of reasons to be cheerful going into his first home game as Scotland head coach. After all, as a newbie to the gig he probably didn’t know any better. Continue reading...

articles.description: Keeper pulled out of Nations League games with Israel Hallgrímsson confident Sunday’s rematch will go ahead The Republic of Ireland manager, Heimir Hallgrímsson, has claimed “a lot of lies” were told over the goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu’s decision to withdraw from the Nations League ​game against Israel last weekend, and he does not anticipate any problems with the second match against them going ahead on Sunday. Ireland are one of Europe’s most outspoken critics of Israel’s war in Gaza, and protests calling for the team to boycott the fixture prompted Bazunu to pull out of both games between the two countries. articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo misses Portugal training amid reports of rift with coach Jesus
articles.dek: Veteran left on bench by Jorge Jesus for win in Norway The 41-year-old has trained alone in gym since weekend Cristiano Ronaldo’s continued absence from Portugal team…
articles.description: Veteran left on bench by Jorge Jesus for win in Norway The 41-year-old has trained alone in gym since weekend Cristiano Ronaldo’s continued absence from Portugal team training has led to speculation that the 41-year-old might miss his country’s match in Denmark on Thursday due to a rift with the head coach, Jorge Jesus. Ronaldo, the all-time leading scorer in men’s international football and pursuing the milestone of 1,000 career goals , was left on the bench on Sunday in Portugal’s 2-1 win at Norway in the Nations League. He has not practised with the team since then, doing only gym work, the Portuguese Football Federation said. Continue reading...
